body: Found by a_capture_download_survives_a_dropped_link (crates/skywave-core/tests/link.rs, #[ignore]d until this is fixed): a 183208 B JPEG capture behind lossy().drop_after_bytes(16..=48 KiB) stays Downloading{got:0} for 20 s; reproduces with SKYWAVE_LINK_SEED=13606245370793176813. Resume by Range from .part exists (blobs.rs:1353, https.rs:1174, api.rs:1716), but got is recorded only after decoded bytes. Suspect: the server's zstd blob frame (skywaved/src/encoding.rs:78, buffers up to a 128 KiB block) yields no decodable bytes before each cut, so every try is zero-progress and backoff escalates. Check block type for incompressible data, and consider smaller frames/blocks or no compression for already-compressed blobs (JPEG/PNG). Un-ignore the test when fixed.
title: blob downloads make no progress when the link drops under ~128 KiB per connection
